amulet-of-retributive-healing.summary: 3 charges, 1d4 back each dawn. When you heal another creature, spend 1 charge to regain the same number of HP yourself.

eternal-chalk.summary: Chalk that never snaps or wears down; you pick its colour and whether the marks glow faintly, and for 7 days nobody but you can erase them.

salubrious-armor.summary: Plate Armor or Scale Mail granting +1 AC; whenever you regain HP it tints red and the bonus is +2 until the end of your next turn.
